subject: Hello
expect: Brief greeting with one helpful question; low/normal, no staff task or owner alert.

subject: Refund request still unresolved
expect: No model generation, draft or new owner alert. Do not resolve or clear the existing sensitive case.

subject: Sleeve measurements
message: What is the exact sleeve length of the Bopop N479 blue grandpa pajamas top in size 4? I already supplied the brand, style and size.
expect: Do not invent measurements or ask for the supplied identity again. Provide a specific staff measurement task and Needs staff input; normal priority.

subject: Tracking follow-up
message: My order #54321 has tracking number TESTTRACK12345, but there has been no scan for 10 days. What should I do?
expect: Use supplied order and tracking identifiers; no repeated identifier request, no invented tracking status. Specific staff check if unavailable.

subject: Gift return portal is broken
message: I received a gift. The gift return portal says invoice TEST-INV-456 is invalid. I already entered that invoice and tried the portal twice. How can I return it?
expect: Do not repeat the broken portal or ask for the same invoice. Specific staff validation task and Needs staff input if no verified alternative.

subject: General shipping hours
message: What days and hours does your warehouse normally process shipments? This is a general question, not about an order.
expect: Answer grounded general hours or hold a specific staff question. Never ask for an order number; low/normal priority.

subject: Can I collect my order?
message: I chose local pickup for order #65432. I have not received a ready-for-pickup notice. Can I collect it now?
expect: Pickup selection does not prove readiness. No collection invitation; explain wait for confirmed readiness or staff verification.

subject: Holiday pickup hours
message: Are you open this coming holiday Monday, and can I use the outside pickup bins?
expect: Distinguish regular staffed hours, unconfirmed holiday opening, bin access and order readiness. No inferred holiday opening or ready order.

subject: Please cancel my order
message: Please cancel order #76543 before it ships. Has it been canceled yet?
expect: Critical/high sensitive escalation; no unsupported cancellation claim or promise. Specific staff confirmation task with known order ID.

subject: Re: Refund request
message: Thanks, but my refund is still missing and I need an update. Order #87654.
expect: Actionable unresolved sensitive follow-up must not be suppressed as thanks. High priority and alert; use supplied ID and specific staff task without refund promises.
